Subject: Intro: Mosaic SDK + Redwood co-bundle idea

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — really helpful. Mosaic Labs builds a prompt orchestration SDK that many LangChain and LlamaIndex users adopt, and we think there's a neat co-bundle opportunity where Mosaic ships a Redwood-backed runtime adapter (tracing + token attribution) out of the box.

High-level ask: are you open to a pilot where we co-package an adapter, add lightweight tracing hooks that map to Redwood trace IDs, and publish a joint README and quickstart? We see this as a channel + product partnership — Mosaic gets a validated Redwood runtime path for our customers and Redwood gets a pre-integrated SDK that speeds adoption.

I've attached a short overview of the SDK and a one-pager on partner benefits. If this sounds interesting, can we schedule a 30m call to align on scope and timelines?

Attachments: mosaic_sdk_overview.pdf

Best,
Alex
Head of Partnerships
Mosaic Labs

Subject: Re: Intro: Mosaic SDK + Redwood co-bundle idea

Thanks for the tag. Quick technical readout & feasibility notes:

Summary of approach:
- Adapter surface: provide a modular Mosaic->Redwood transport layer that implements:
  - token_count hooks (post-response) to populate attribution metrics
  - trace initiation: Mosaic SDK should call Redwood Trace.start(span) with a short meta blob (sdk_version, model_id, prompt_hash)
  - KV cache hints: optional header to indicate prefix caching eligibility

Compatibility matrix:
- LangChain: provide an LLM wrapper class that sets a Redwood-compatible base_url and attaches the trace id header; will include an example using RLHF-style multi-turn sequences
- LlamaIndex: small shim for DocumentStore clients to forward request metadata and allow Redwood to record per-document token attribution

Telemetry & privacy:
- We'll support a minimal telemetry payload by default (trace_id, token_count, model_id). No user PII should be sent. For customers needing audit logs, we can enable expanded telemetry under explicit consent and an enterprise flag.

Rough ETA: 3 weeks for an initial adapter PR + docs, 1 week for partner README and quickstart once we have access to a Mosaic test account.

I'll prepare a technical checklist for the pilot call; can Marissa confirm the inclusion of a 60-day pilot pricing line and co-marketing deliverables in the SOW?

Sooj
